Why a term needs an owner. One example of a stated expectation: the Danish Medicines Agency's page on linguistic proofreading of product information for centrally authorised medicinal products lists, among the standards it expects that product information meets, that the choice of words and the use of terminology is consistent, and that the Danish translation is a faithful translation of the original text. That page covers medicines product information (the page is dated 3 April 2017; read 16 November 2026). It does not cover medical devices or clinical-trial material, so use it as an example of a stated expectation, not as a rule for your deliverable. Source: https://laegemiddelstyrelsen.dk/en/licensing/licensing-of-medicines/spcs,-package-leaflets-and-labelling/linguistic-proofreading-of-product-information-for-centrally-authorised-medicinal-products/
